findings.evidence: R-14 (ipLimit checked only in new_inbound_slot) + R-15 (duplicate endpoint only) + R-43 (model): one attacker IP with 10 distinct ports fills all 10 default outbound slots.
findings.title: Outbound slots have no per-IP cap: one attacker IP with 10 distinct ports fills all 10 default outbound slots

findings.evidence: R-13 (ipLimit is per exact IP only) + R-14 + absence grep: 'diversity' 0 hits, 'subnet' 0 hits in src/xrpld/overlay and src/xrpld/peerfinder.
findings.title: No subnet or prefix diversity anywhere in peer selection; ipLimit 2 is per exact IP only, inbound only

findings.evidence: R-18 (fixed/reserved bypass all caps in Counts.h:77-78) + PeerReservationTable has no size limit in the pinned source.
findings.title: Reserved and cluster slots bypass all caps with no bound on the reservation count

findings.evidence: R-21 (redirect gives up to 10 endpoints; up to 30 redirect IPs enter the bootcache, Logic.h:1274-1280) with no connectivity test on redirect IPs.
findings.title: Redirect IPs enter the bootcache unchecked, up to 30 per redirect: a full peer can poison caches

findings.evidence: R-24 (handshake verifies a session signature) + R-27 (key must be secp256k1) + R-40 (deleting databases creates a new node key pair): identity costs nothing and the handshake only proves key possession.
findings.title: Sybil identities are free: a fresh secp256k1 node key costs nothing and the handshake only proves key possession

findings.evidence: R-11 (bootcache valence resets to -1 on one failure, Bootcache.cpp:176-190); valence is local-only.
findings.title: Bootcache valence is local-only and one failure resets it to -1, so a popular honest hub can be demoted by a single failed attempt

findings.evidence: R-36 (endpoint messages over 64 entries are sampled at random; acceptance rate-limited to once per 151 s per peer, Logic.h:789-823).
findings.title: Endpoint gossip accepts up to 64 entries per message and samples oversize messages at random, so attacker entries can displace honest ones

findings.evidence: R-07 (fixed peers tried first) + bootstrap defaults are 4 third-party DNS pools (OverlayImpl.cpp:490-515); the default configuration has no fixed peers.
findings.title: Fixed peers are the only anchor, and they are config-only: the default configuration has no fixed peers

findings.evidence: R-26 (clock skew over 20 s is rejected, Handshake.cpp:252-278).
findings.title: Clock tolerance is 20 seconds: a peer 21 seconds off is rejected even if honest

findings.evidence: R-31 (onTimer evicts diverged over 300 s and unknown over 600 s outbound peers only, PeerImp.cpp:728-762).
findings.title: Diverged and unknown eviction applies to outbound peers only; a diverged inbound peer is kept

findings.evidence: Counts.h:212-224 defines isConnectedToNetwork; grep shows it is never called anywhere in src/; as written it returns false whenever m_out_max > 0.
findings.title: isConnectedToNetwork is dead code: no live connectedness signal is computed from outbound counts

findings.evidence: peerfinder Tuning.h:40 defines secondsPerConnect = 10; grep shows it is never used anywhere in src/; autoconnect actually runs on the 1 s overlay timer (OverlayImpl.cpp:88).
findings.title: secondsPerConnect (10 s) is defined but unused; autoconnect actually runs on the 1 s overlay timer
